question: Estimate the size of the Indian Gen Z consumer segment (born 1997-2012).
idealClarificationQuestions: Gen Z population in India in 2026 (age 14-29)? Yes.
Annual consumer market driven by Gen Z? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Population × earning/spending share × spend per individual.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Gen Z India in 2026 (age 14-29): ~380M (~26% of population).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, students with family-financed discretionary: ~150M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Average annual personal spend (across employed + student categories): ~₹35,000 blended.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus indirect influence on family purchase decisions (cars, brands, where to eat): ~2x of direct spend = ₹15-20 lakh Cr.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Of these, students with family-financed discretionary
Total Gen Z with consumer purchasing influence
Average annual personal spend (across employed + student categories)
Total Gen Z direct consumer market

calculationFlow: Average annual personal spend (across employed + student categories): ~₹35,000 blended.
Total Gen Z direct consumer market: 270M × ₹35K = ~₹9.5 lakh Cr.
Plus indirect influence on family purchase decisions (cars, brands, where to eat): ~2x of direct spend = ₹15-20 lakh Cr.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Plus indirect influence on family purchase decisions (cars, brands, where to eat): ~2x of direct spend = ₹15-20 lakh Cr.
